name: mockmatch
description: Checks a website against its design and drives a headless browser for the agent: an agent drives a headless browser with deterministic commands instead of guesses from screenshots — the page as text, clicks that report what changed, input, console errors, computed styles — and checks the site against the design (a Claude Design frame, an HTML mockup or a PNG): element-by-element style and geometry diff, pixel regions with crops, an HTML board and a subagent verdict.
